why: Most of the issue matches the repository. math.js exists and exports add, subtract, multiply and average. average's body really is `xs.reduce(...)/xs.length`. test/math.test.js really covers only add, subtract and multiply. `npm test` maps to `node --test` in package.json. The node -e commands use real exports. The break is in the regression proof, which runs `git checkout c82b37b -- math.js`. Nothing in the repository facts gives a commit hash, so `c82b37b` looks made up. If that hash isn't the real base commit, the command fails and the check can't be run. That proof relies on a repository fact that isn't shown and was probably invented, so the issue doesn't fully match the repository as it is.
